verdict.rationale: The featurebase-js SDK's boot lifecycle (docs-20, docs-21, docs-22) implies passing user context when initializing the widget, which is the standard mechanism for tying feedback to an existing account, but the evidence never explicitly documents passing user ID/email/JWT or secure user-identity verification for feedback submission. missing for 10: explicit documentation of identify/authenticate user fields (id, email, name), secure hash/JWT verification for user identity, and confirmation that submitted feedback links to the account record.
